<thought>We need to locate the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target molecule, yields the three precursor SMILES provided. The template should correspond to a Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) reaction, which in the forward direction forms a C=C double bond and an aliphatic carboxylic acid while breaking a C‑P bond and a C‑O bond. Using these functional‑group criteria we can query the template catalog and retrieve the matching template ID and its SMARTS. Then we will map the reaction SMILES (product >> precursors) to obtain the required `mapped_rxn` string.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["carboxylic acid", "C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C (double)"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
